regions.today: It will become mostly cloudy this evening as some patchy light rain and drizzle slowly spreads from the west along with some mist and hill fog. The southeast of the Province will remain dry until later in the night. Winds will be light southeasterly.
regions.tonight: The cloud, patchy drizzle, mist and hill fog will continue to slowly move southeastwards tonight with a clearance to dry colder and clear conditions gradually following from the west. Feeling cooler further north with lows of 2 to 4 degrees and warmer further south with lows of 5 to 9 degrees. Light southeasterly winds will veer northerly as the rain clears.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be a dry and bright day with plenty of sunshine although a bit cloudier at first in the southeast. Highs of 11 to 13 degrees with light to moderate northerly breezes.
